title: ZXTank Accessibility
description: Read the current, verification-gated accessibility information for ZXTank while the game remains in development.
summary: Detailed ZXTank accessibility information will be published after physical-device verification.
heroImageAlt: BarkinMad Studios placeholder artwork while ZXTank accessibility information is prepared

sections.heading: Accessibility During Development
paragraphs: Accessibility is being considered during ZXTank development alongside controls, presentation and game flow.
This is not a formal accessibility certification or a claim of WCAG conformance.

sections.heading: Features Verified in the Current Build
paragraphs: No detailed accessibility features are published yet because physical-device accessibility testing has not been completed for the release build.
Detailed information will be added only after verification on supported devices and assistive technologies.

sections.heading: Planned or Unvalidated Features
paragraphs: Potential accessibility improvements may change during development and are not commitments until they have been implemented and validated.
This page will identify verified features separately from planned work when that evidence is available.

sections.heading: Not Currently Supported
paragraphs: No universal-accessibility claim is made for ZXTank at this stage.
If a feature is not listed as verified, its availability should be treated as unconfirmed until this page is updated after testing.
